response.description: Regulated customers running AKS Confidential VM node pools protect workloads in memory today, but the OS disk isn't encrypted at rest, so they have to close the data-at-rest gap outside the platform. In Preview, Ubuntu 26.04 Confidential VM node pools enable OS Disk Encryption by default on both Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP SKUs, so the OS disk is protected with a CVM-bound key from first boot. Confidential workloads get end-to-end confidentiality (memory and OS disk) without new configuration, new API surface, or changes to existing tooling.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Confidential VMs with OS Disk Encryption support on AKS
